help.en: An area of the data platform that holds stores, datasets and pipelines at one level of refinement: raw data as it arrives, curated data that is cleaned and joined, or serving data that is ready to use.
The person or team accountable for it.
How many things flow directly into it.
How many things it flows directly into.
Anything data passes through: a source, a pipeline, a store, a dataset, a model, a service or a consumer.
What kind of system it is, in your own words, such as "CRM" or "Billing system".
A system where data starts: an operational application, a device or a partner feed.
How data is brought in from a source: a batch import, a stream of events or change data capture.
What runs it, such as "SQL jobs" or "Scheduled scripts".
What the pipeline does to the data.
A job that reads data, cleans, joins or reshapes it, and writes the result.
Where the data is kept, such as a country or a data centre region.
On when the store has been approved to hold personal data.
A place where data is kept: a lake, a warehouse, a lakehouse, a database, a feature store or a vector store.
How the data is laid out, such as "Table" or "Files".

constraints.message: A dataset that contains personal data should not be classified as Public.

help.en: A named, governed set of data that people and models use, such as a table of customer profiles.
How quality is measured, such as "AUC" or "RMSE".
A trained machine learning model, with the task it does and how well it does it.
Where it is reached, such as a path or an address.
Something that puts AI to use for others: an API, an agent or a chat assistant.
Public when people outside the organisation see what it shows.
Whoever or whatever uses the data in the end: a dashboard, an application, an analyst or an external partner.

= 'The restricted dataset "' + from.Name + '" flows to "' + to.Name + '", which has a public audience.'

help.en: Data moves from one thing to the next. Say how often, in what format, and whether it carries personal data.
How it is delivered, such as "API call" or "Nightly scores".
A model or an AI service delivers its results to a service or a consumer.
A model learns from this dataset, or is validated or tested on it.
The data platform of one product or initiative: where data comes from, how it moves and who uses it.
